"""ORM models — physical realisation of docs/04-data-model.md (+ reasoning-practice learning domain).

Portable across SQLite (dev/test) and PostgreSQL (prod). UUIDs are stored as 36-char strings.
Export PostgreSQL DDL with:  python -m leetmath.cli ddl --dialect postgresql
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal

from sqlalchemy import (
    JSON,
    Boolean,
    CheckConstraint,
    DateTime,
    ForeignKey,
    Index,
    Integer,
    Numeric,
    String,
    Text,
    UniqueConstraint,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship

from .db import Base


def new_id() -> str:
    return str(uuid.uuid4())


def utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


UUID = String(36)
TS = DateTime(timezone=True)
SCORE = Numeric(8, 2)

REVISION_STATUSES = (
    "draft",
    "in_math_review",
    "in_rights_review",
    "approved",
    "published",
    "archived",
    "retracted",
)
RESPONSE_TYPES = (
    "single_choice",
    "multiple_choice",
    "integer",
    "decimal",
    "rational",
    "expression",
    "equation_set",
    "interval",
    "set",
    "matrix",
    "vector",
    "short_text",
    "proof",
    "derivation",
    "drawing",
)
EVAL_STATUSES = (
    "queued",
    "running",
    "accepted",
    "rejected",
    "partial",
    "invalid_response",
    "pending_review",
    "engine_error",
    "cancelled",
)
ROLES = ("student", "editor", "reviewer", "rights_reviewer", "source_manager", "admin", "auditor")


# ───────────────────────────── identity ─────────────────────────────
class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    username: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), unique=True, nullable=False)
    display_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), nullable=False, default="")
    # A user may hold several roles, stored as a sorted comma list (",editor,reviewer,").
    roles: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(256), nullable=False, default=",student,")
    password_hash: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(256), nullable=False)
    privacy_flags: Mapped[dict] = mapped_column(JSON, default=dict)
    timezone: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), default="Asia/Shanghai")
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)

    @property
    def role_set(self) -> set[str]:
        return {r for r in self.roles.split(",") if r}


class AuthSession(Base):
    __tablename__ = "auth_sessions"
    token_hash: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), primary_key=True)
    user_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False, index=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)
    expires_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, nullable=False)
    revoked: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False)


class IdempotencyRecord(Base):
    __tablename__ = "idempotency_records"
    scope: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(160), primary_key=True)
    key: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), primary_key=True)
    request_hash: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    status_code: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False)
    response: Mapped[dict] = mapped_column(JSON, nullable=False)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)


# ───────────────────────────── A. sources & governance ─────────────────────────────
class Source(Base):
    __tablename__ = "sources"
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), unique=True, nullable=False)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(256), nullable=False)
    kind: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False)  # internal/partner/open_license/document/teacher_private/legacy
    homepage: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(512))
    owner: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(256))
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), default="active")  # active/disabled
    default_visibility: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), default="public")  # teacher_private → private
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)


class RightsGrant(Base):
    __tablename__ = "rights_grants"
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), unique=True, nullable=False)
    source_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("sources.id"), nullable=False, index=True)
    grant_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False)  # original/license/contract/open_license
    scope: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(256), default="")
    territory: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), default="WORLD")
    permitted_actions: Mapped[list] = mapped_column(JSON, default=list)  # display/reproduce/adapt/redistribute/export/commercial
    attribution_text: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)
    valid_from: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(TS)
    valid_to: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(TS)
    evidence_ref: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(512))
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), default="active")  # pending/active/revoked
    reviewed_by: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("users.id"))
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)


class SourceRecord(Base):
    __tablename__ = "source_records"
    __table_args__ = (UniqueConstraint("source_id", "external_id"),)
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    source_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("sources.id"), nullable=False)
    external_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(256), nullable=False)
    latest_source_revision: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(128))
    canonical_problem_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("problems.id"))
    relation_to_problem: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(32))  # origin/exact_duplicate/adapted_from
    tombstoned: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)


class SourceRecordRevision(Base):
    __tablename__ = "source_record_revisions"
    __table_args__ = (UniqueConstraint("source_record_id", "external_revision"),)
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    source_record_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("source_records.id"), nullable=False)
    external_revision: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), nullable=False)
    raw_object_key: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(512), nullable=False)
    raw_sha256: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    adapter_version: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    normalizer_version: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    normalized_payload: Mapped[dict | None] = mapped_column(JSON)
    content_hash: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), index=True)
    batch_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("import_batches.id"))
    problem_revision_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("problem_revisions.id"))
    imported_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)


class ImportBatch(Base):
    __tablename__ = "import_batches"
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    source_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("sources.id"), nullable=False)
    idempotency_key: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), unique=True, nullable=False)
    manifest: Mapped[dict] = mapped_column(JSON, nullable=False)
    manifest_hash: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    importer_version: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False)
    dry_run: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=True)
    state: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(24), default="created")  # created/running/completed/completed_with_errors/failed
    counts: Mapped[dict] = mapped_column(JSON, default=dict)
    initiated_by: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False)
    started_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)
    finished_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(TS)


class ImportRow(Base):
    __tablename__ = "import_rows"
    __table_args__ = (UniqueConstraint("batch_id", "row_no"), Index("ix_import_rows_batch_state", "batch_id", "state"))
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    batch_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("import_batches.id"), nullable=False)
    file_path: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(512), nullable=False)
    row_no: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False)
    source_record_key: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(256), index=True)
    raw_sha256: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    raw_object_key: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(512), nullable=False)
    # outcome: retained/new_record/new_revision/duplicate_candidate/rejected/quarantined/validated(dry-run)/failed
    state: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(24), nullable=False)
    stage: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(24), nullable=False)
    error_code: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(48))
    error_detail: Mapped[dict | None] = mapped_column(JSON)
    outcome_entity_type: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(48))
    outcome_entity_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow, onupdate=utcnow)


class DuplicateCandidate(Base):
    __tablename__ = "duplicate_candidates"
    __table_args__ = (Index("ix_dup_status_score", "status", "score"),)
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    left_source_record_revision_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        UUID, ForeignKey("source_record_revisions.id"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    right_problem_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("problems.id"), nullable=False)
    level: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(8), nullable=False)  # L1 exact / L2 near
    score: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(6, 4), nullable=False)
    signals: Mapped[dict] = mapped_column(JSON, default=dict)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(24), default="pending")  # pending/resolved/deferred
    decision: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(32))  # exact_duplicate/independent/isomorphic_to/adapted_from
    decision_reason: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)
    reviewer_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("users.id"))
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)
    resolved_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(TS)


class ContentReport(Base):
    __tablename__ = "content_reports"
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    reporter_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False, index=True)
    problem_revision_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("problem_revisions.id"), nullable=False)
    revision_part_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("revision_parts.id"))
    evaluation_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("evaluations.id"))
    kind: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False)  # wrong_answer/ambiguous/missing_image/misjudged/rights/other
    description: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, default="")
    severity: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(4), default="P2")
    state: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), default="open")  # open/triaged/resolved/rejected
    public_note: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)
    internal_note: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)
    reviewer_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("users.id"))
    resolution: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64))
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow, onupdate=utcnow)


class AuditEvent(Base):
    """Append-only. No API updates or deletes these rows."""

    __tablename__ = "audit_events"
    __table_args__ = (Index("ix_audit_entity", "entity_type", "entity_id", "created_at"),)
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    actor_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("users.id"))
    action: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    entity_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(48), nullable=False)
    entity_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    before_hash: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64))
    after_hash: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64))
    meta: Mapped[dict] = mapped_column(JSON, default=dict)
    request_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64))
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)


class WorkflowEvent(Base):
    __tablename__ = "content_workflow_events"
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    revision_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("problem_revisions.id"), nullable=False, index=True)
    from_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(24), nullable=False)
    to_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(24), nullable=False)
    actor_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False)
    reason: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)


class OutboxEvent(Base):
    __tablename__ = "outbox_events"
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    topic: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    payload: Mapped[dict] = mapped_column(JSON, nullable=False)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)
    processed_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(TS)


# ───────────────────────────── B. canonical problems ─────────────────────────────
class Problem(Base):
    __tablename__ = "problems"
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    display_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), unique=True, nullable=False)
    slug: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(160), unique=True, nullable=False)
    grade_band: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False)
    subject: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False, default="mathematics")
    visibility: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), default="public")  # public/private
    current_public_revision_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(
        UUID, ForeignKey("problem_revisions.id", use_alter=True, name="fk_problem_current_rev")
    )
    takedown_hold: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False)
    takedown_reason: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)
    created_by: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("users.id"))
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)
    deleted_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(TS)


class SlugAlias(Base):
    """Old slugs are never re-used (docs/01 §4.1)."""

    __tablename__ = "problem_slug_aliases"
    slug: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(160), primary_key=True)
    problem_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("problems.id"), nullable=False)


class ProblemRevision(Base):
    __tablename__ = "problem_revisions"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("problem_id", "revision_no"),
        CheckConstraint("revision_no > 0", name="ck_revision_no_pos"),
        CheckConstraint(
            "status IN ('draft','in_math_review','in_rights_review','approved','published','archived','retracted')",
            name="ck_revision_status",
        ),
        Index("ix_rev_status_pub", "status", "published_at"),
    )
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    problem_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("problems.id"), nullable=False)
    revision_no: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(24), nullable=False, default="draft")
    locale: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), nullable=False, default="zh-CN")
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(256), nullable=False)
    shared_statement: Mapped[dict] = mapped_column(JSON, nullable=False)
    content_metadata: Mapped[dict] = mapped_column(JSON, default=dict)
    platform_difficulty: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Integer)
    revision_kind: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(24), default="initial")  # initial/semantic/presentation
    change_note: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)
    content_hash: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64))
    rights_grant_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("rights_grants.id"))
    lock_version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)
    created_by: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("users.id"))
    math_reviewer_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("users.id"))
    rights_reviewer_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("users.id"))
    review_note: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)
    published_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(TS)
    retracted_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(TS)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(TS, default=utcnow)

    parts: Mapped[list["RevisionPart"]] = relationship(
        back_populates="revision", order_by="RevisionPart.display_order", cascade="all, delete-orphan"
    )


class LogicalPart(Base):
    __tablename__ = "logical_parts"
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    problem_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("problems.id"), nullable=False, index=True)
    stable_label: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64))


class RevisionPart(Base):
    __tablename__ = "revision_parts"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("problem_revision_id", "logical_part_id"),
        UniqueConstraint("problem_revision_id", "display_order"),
        CheckConstraint("display_order > 0", name="ck_part_order_pos"),
        CheckConstraint("max_score > 0", name="ck_part_max_score_pos"),
    )
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    problem_revision_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("problem_revisions.id"), nullable=False)
    logical_part_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("logical_parts.id"), nullable=False)
    part_key: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), nullable=False)
    display_order: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False)
    prompt: Mapped[dict] = mapped_column(JSON, nullable=False)
    response_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False)
    max_score: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(SCORE, nullable=False)
    options: Mapped[list | None] = mapped_column(JSON)  # choice options [{id, content}]
    knowledge_codes: Mapped[list] = mapped_column(JSON, default=list)
    # Emergency switch (docs/01 UC-04): pause automatic grading without retracting.
    grading_suspended: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False)

    revision: Mapped[ProblemRevision] = relationship(back_populates="parts")
    answer_specs: Mapped[list["AnswerSpec"]] = relationship(
        order_by="AnswerSpec.spec_version", cascade="all, delete-orphan"
    )
    solutions: Mapped[list["Solution"]] = relationship(cascade="all, delete-orphan")


class AnswerSpec(Base):
    __tablename__ = "answer_specs"
    __table_args__ = (UniqueConstraint("revision_part_id", "spec_version"),)
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    revision_part_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("revision_parts.id"), nullable=False)
    spec_version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)
    grading_mode: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), nullable=False)  # automatic/manual/hybrid/practice_only
    checker_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(48), nullable=False)
    spec: Mapped[dict] = mapped_column(JSON, nullable=False)  # expected answer + checker config (hidden)
    rubric: Mapped[dict | None] = mapped_column(JSON)  # {version, criteria[], policy}
    rubric_sum: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(SCORE)


class Solution(Base):
    __tablename__ = "solutions"
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    revision_part_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("revision_parts.id"), nullable=False)
    solution_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(24), nullable=False)
    content: Mapped[dict] = mapped_column(JSON, nullable=False)
    validation_state: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), default="unreviewed")
    reviewer_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(UUID, ForeignKey("users.id"))


class Asset(Base):

"""Append-only audit trail + outbox (docs/04 §7, docs/08 §8)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import contextvars

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ..content.contract import canonical_json, sha256_text
from ..models import AuditEvent, OutboxEvent

request_id_var: contextvars.ContextVar[str | None] = contextvars.ContextVar("request_id", default=None)


def _h(obj) -> str | None:
    return None if obj is None else sha256_text(canonical_json(obj))


def audit(
    s: Session,
    actor_id: str | None,
    action: str,
    entity_type: str,
    entity_id: str,
    before=None,
    after=None,
    **meta,
) -> AuditEvent:
    ev = AuditEvent(
        actor_id=actor_id,
        action=action,
        entity_type=entity_type,
        entity_id=str(entity_id),
        before_hash=_h(before),
        after_hash=_h(after),
        meta=meta,
        request_id=request_id_var.get(),
    )
    s.add(ev)
    return ev


def outbox(s: Session, topic: str, **payload) -> None:
    s.add(OutboxEvent(topic=topic, payload=payload))

"""Problem identity, revisions, workflow & publishing (docs/01 UC-01, docs/03, docs/04 §3, docs/08 §3).

Invariants enforced here (and by the before_flush guard below):
* Published/archived/retracted revisions are content-immutable; edits create a new draft revision.
* logical_part_id is stable across revisions; revision_part_id is per revision.
* Publishing requires: approved status, two distinct gates (math + rights), no self-approval,
  zero blocking preflight issues, and a rights grant valid *now* for `display`.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal

from sqlalchemy import event, func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ..config import settings
from ..content.contract import content_hash, preflight
from ..content.richtext import to_plain_text
from ..models import (
    AnswerSpec,
    CurriculumRelease,
    CurriculumSystem,
    KnowledgeNode,
    LogicalPart,
    Problem,
    ProblemRevision,
    ReasoningStep,
    RevisionKnowledge,
    RevisionPart,
    RightsGrant,
    SearchDocument,
    SlugAlias,
    Solution,
    Source,
    SourceRecord,
    User,
    WorkflowEvent,
    utcnow,
)
from .audit import audit, outbox
from .errors import ApiError
from .rights import grant_allows, grant_by_ref

FROZEN = {"published", "archived", "retracted"}
# Columns that may still change on a frozen revision (status transitions + bookkeeping only).
_MUTABLE_ON_FROZEN = {
    ProblemRevision: {"status", "retracted_at", "updated_at", "review_note", "published_at", "lock_version"},
    RevisionPart: {"grading_suspended"},
}


@event.listens_for(Session, "before_flush")
def _immutability_guard(session: Session, _ctx, _instances):  # pragma: no cover - exercised via tests
    from sqlalchemy import inspect as sa_inspect

    for obj in list(session.dirty) + list(session.deleted):
        rev: ProblemRevision | None = None
        if isinstance(obj, ProblemRevision):
            rev = obj
            hist_status = sa_inspect(obj).attrs.status.history
            old_status = hist_status.deleted[0] if hist_status.deleted else obj.status
            if old_status not in FROZEN:
                continue
        elif isinstance(obj, (RevisionPart, AnswerSpec, Solution, ReasoningStep)):
            part_rev_id = getattr(obj, "problem_revision_id", None)
            if part_rev_id is None:
                part = obj if isinstance(obj, RevisionPart) else session.get(RevisionPart, obj.revision_part_id)
                part_rev_id = part.problem_revision_id if part else None
            rev = session.get(ProblemRevision, part_rev_id) if part_rev_id else None
            if rev is None or rev.status not in FROZEN:
                continue
        else:
            continue
        if obj in session.deleted:
            raise ApiError("INVALID_STATE", "published content cannot be deleted; retract instead")
        allowed = _MUTABLE_ON_FROZEN.get(type(obj), set())
        state = sa_inspect(obj)
        changed = {a.key for a in state.attrs if a.history.has_changes()} - allowed
        changed -= {"parts", "answer_specs", "solutions", "revision"}  # relationship bookkeeping
        if changed:
            raise ApiError("INVALID_STATE", f"revision is {rev.status}; content is immutable (changed: {sorted(changed)})")


# ─────────────────────────── helpers ───────────────────────────
def _region_prefix(doc: dict) -> str:
    for r in doc["revision"]["content_metadata"].get("region_hints", []):
        m = re.match(r"^[A-Z]{2}-([A-Z]{2,4})$", r)
        if m:
            return m.group(1)
    return "GEN"


def _next_display_id(s: Session, prefix: str) -> str:
    like = f"LM-{prefix}-%"
    rows = s.scalars(select(Problem.display_id).where(Problem.display_id.like(like))).all()
    n = max((int(r.rsplit("-", 1)[1]) for r in rows), default=0) + 1
    return f"LM-{prefix}-{n:06d}"


def _slug_taken(s: Session, slug: str, problem_id: str | None = None) -> bool:
    p = s.scalar(select(Problem).where(Problem.slug == slug))
    if p and p.id != problem_id:
        return True
    a = s.get(SlugAlias, slug)
    return bool(a and a.problem_id != problem_id)


def _knowledge_node(s: Session, system_code: str, release_code: str, code: str) -> KnowledgeNode | None:
    return s.scalar(
        select(KnowledgeNode)
        .join(CurriculumRelease, KnowledgeNode.release_id == CurriculumRelease.id)
        .join(CurriculumSystem, CurriculumRelease.system_id == CurriculumSystem.id)
        .where(CurriculumSystem.code == system_code, CurriculumRelease.release_code == release_code,
               KnowledgeNode.external_code == code)
    )


def _record_workflow(s: Session, rev: ProblemRevision, to: str, actor: User, reason: str | None = None) -> None:
    s.add(WorkflowEvent(revision_id=rev.id, from_status=rev.status, to_status=to, actor_id=actor.id, reason=reason))
    audit(s, actor.id, f"revision.{to}", "problem_revision", rev.id, meta_from=rev.status, reason=reason)
    rev.status = to
    rev.updated_at = utcnow()


def require_roles(user: User | None, *roles: str) -> User:
    if user is None:
        raise ApiError("AUTH_REQUIRED", "login required")
    if not (user.role_set & (set(roles) | {"admin"})):
        raise ApiError("FORBIDDEN", f"requires role: {' / '.join(roles)}")
    return user


# ─────────────────────────── doc → DB ───────────────────────────
def _write_parts(s: Session, problem: Problem, rev: ProblemRevision, doc: dict, prev: ProblemRevision | None) -> None:
    prev_by_key: dict[str, str] = {}
    if prev is not None:
        prev_by_key = {p.part_key: p.logical_part_id for p in prev.parts}
    existing_logical = {lp.id for lp in s.scalars(select(LogicalPart).where(LogicalPart.problem_id == problem.id))}
    for pd in sorted(doc["revision"]["parts"], key=lambda p: p["display_order"]):
        lid = pd.get("logical_part_id")
        if lid and lid not in existing_logical:
            if s.get(LogicalPart, lid) is not None:  # belongs to another problem → never reuse
                lid = None
            else:
                s.add(LogicalPart(id=lid, problem_id=problem.id, stable_label=pd["part_key"]))
                existing_logical.add(lid)
        if not lid:
            lid = prev_by_key.get(pd["part_key"])
        if not lid:
            lp = LogicalPart(problem_id=problem.id, stable_label=pd["part_key"])
            s.add(lp)
            s.flush()
            lid = lp.id
            existing_logical.add(lid)
        part = RevisionPart(
            problem_revision_id=rev.id,
            logical_part_id=lid,
            part_key=pd["part_key"],
            display_order=pd["display_order"],
            prompt=pd["prompt"],
            response_type=pd["response_type"],
            max_score=Decimal(pd["max_score"]),
            options=pd.get("options"),
            knowledge_codes=pd.get("knowledge_codes")
            or [m["knowledge_code"] for m in doc["revision"]["content_metadata"].get("curriculum_mappings", [])
                if m.get("relation_type", "tested") == "tested"],
        )
        if pd.get("id") and s.get(RevisionPart, pd["id"]) is None:
            part.id = pd["id"]
        rev.parts.append(part)
        s.flush()
        spec = dict(pd["answer_spec"])
        rubric = pd.get("rubric")
        part.answer_specs.append(
            AnswerSpec(
                spec_version=spec.pop("spec_version", 1),
                grading_mode=spec.pop("grading_mode"),
                checker_type=spec.pop("checker_type"),
                spec=spec,
                rubric=rubric,
                rubric_sum=sum(Decimal(c["max_points"]) for c in rubric["criteria"]) if rubric else None,
            )
        )
        for sol in pd.get("solutions") or []:
            part.solutions.append(
                Solution(solution_type=sol["type"], content={"steps": sol["steps"]},
                         validation_state=sol.get("review_state", "unreviewed"))
            )
        for st in pd.get("reasoning_steps") or []:
            s.add(ReasoningStep(
                revision_part_id=part.id, semantic_key=st["semantic_key"], step_order=st["order"],
                recall_cue=st["recall_cue"], reference_latex=st["reference_latex"],
                explanation=st.get("explanation", ""), max_points=Decimal(st["max_points"]),
                criticality=st.get("criticality", "normal"), knowledge_codes=st.get("knowledge_codes", []),
            ))


def _write_revision_body(s: Session, problem: Problem, rev: ProblemRevision, doc: dict, prev: ProblemRevision | None):
    r = doc["revision"]
    md = r["content_metadata"]
    rev.title = r["title"]
    rev.locale = r["locale"]
    rev.shared_statement = r["shared_statement"]
    rev.content_metadata = md
    rev.platform_difficulty = (md.get("platform_difficulty") or {}).get("value")
    rev.revision_kind = r.get("revision_kind", "initial" if prev is None else "semantic")
    rev.change_note = r.get("change_note")
    rev.content_metadata = {**md, "_source_record_refs": doc["source_record_refs"],
                            "_rights_policy_ref": doc["rights_policy_ref"], "_assets": doc.get("assets", []),
                            "_lineage": doc.get("lineage", [])}
    grant = grant_by_ref(s, doc["rights_policy_ref"])
    rev.rights_grant_id = grant.id if grant else None
    rev.content_hash = content_hash(doc)
    s.flush()
    _write_parts(s, problem, rev, doc, prev)
    for m in md.get("curriculum_mappings", []):
        node = _knowledge_node(s, m["curriculum_code"], m["release_code"], m["knowledge_code"])
        if node and not s.get(RevisionKnowledge, (rev.id, node.id, m.get("relation_type", "tested"))):
            s.add(RevisionKnowledge(revision_id=rev.id, knowledge_node_id=node.id,
                                    relation_type=m.get("relation_type", "tested"),
                                    weight=Decimal(str(m.get("weight", 1)))))


def create_problem(s: Session, doc: dict, actor: User, visibility: str | None = None) -> ProblemRevision:
    pd = doc["problem"]
    display_id = pd.get("display_id")
    if display_id and s.scalar(select(Problem).where(Problem.display_id == display_id)):
        display_id = None
    display_id = display_id or _next_display_id(s, _region_prefix(doc))
    slug = pd.get("slug")
    if not slug or _slug_taken(s, slug):
        slug = display_id.lower()
    problem = Problem(display_id=display_id, slug=slug, grade_band=pd["grade_band"],
                      subject=pd.get("subject", "mathematics"),
                      visibility=visibility or pd.get("visibility", "public"), created_by=actor.id)
    if pd.get("id") and s.get(Problem, pd["id"]) is None:
        problem.id = pd["id"]
    s.add(problem)
    s.flush()
    rev = ProblemRevision(problem_id=problem.id, revision_no=1, status="draft", title="", shared_statement={},
                          created_by=actor.id)
    if doc["revision"].get("id") and s.get(ProblemRevision, doc["revision"]["id"]) is None:
        rev.id = doc["revision"]["id"]
    s.add(rev)
    _write_revision_body(s, problem, rev, doc, None)
    audit(s, actor.id, "problem.create", "problem", problem.id, after={"display_id": display_id})
    return rev


def update_draft(s: Session, rev: ProblemRevision, doc: dict, actor: User, if_match: int | None) -> ProblemRevision:
    if rev.status != "draft":
        raise ApiError("INVALID_STATE", f"only drafts are editable (status={rev.status}); create a new revision")
    if if_match is None:
        raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "If-Match header with lock_version is required", status=428)
    if int(if_match) != rev.lock_version:
        raise ApiError("EDIT_CONFLICT", "draft was modified by someone else",
                       {"current_lock_version": rev.lock_version, "updated_at": rev.updated_at.isoformat()})
    before = rev.content_hash
    problem = s.get(Problem, rev.problem_id)
    for part in list(rev.parts):
        for st in s.scalars(select(ReasoningStep).where(ReasoningStep.revision_part_id == part.id)):
            s.delete(st)
    s.execute(RevisionKnowledge.__table__.delete().where(RevisionKnowledge.revision_id == rev.id))
    rev.parts.clear()
    s.flush()
    prev = _previous_revision(s, rev)
    _write_revision_body(s, problem, rev, doc, prev)
    rev.lock_version += 1
    rev.updated_at = utcnow()
    audit(s, actor.id, "revision.edit", "problem_revision", rev.id, before=before, after=rev.content_hash)
    return rev


def _previous_revision(s: Session, rev: ProblemRevision) -> ProblemRevision | None:
    return s.scalar(select(ProblemRevision).where(ProblemRevision.problem_id == rev.problem_id,
                                                  ProblemRevision.revision_no < rev.revision_no)
                    .order_by(ProblemRevision.revision_no.desc()).limit(1))


def new_revision(s: Session, problem: Problem, actor: User, doc: dict | None = None) -> ProblemRevision:
    open_draft = s.scalar(select(ProblemRevision).where(ProblemRevision.problem_id == problem.id,
                                                        ProblemRevision.status.in_(("draft", "in_math_review", "in_rights_review", "approved"))))
    if open_draft:
        raise ApiError("INVALID_STATE", "an unpublished revision already exists", {"revision_id": open_draft.id})
    latest = s.scalar(select(ProblemRevision).where(ProblemRevision.problem_id == problem.id)
                      .order_by(ProblemRevision.revision_no.desc()).limit(1))
    base_doc = doc or revision_to_doc(s, latest)
    base_doc["revision"].pop("id", None)
    for p in base_doc["revision"]["parts"]:
        p.pop("id", None)
    rev = ProblemRevision(problem_id=problem.id, revision_no=latest.revision_no + 1, status="draft", title="",
                          shared_statement={}, created_by=actor.id)
    s.add(rev)
    _write_revision_body(s, problem, rev, base_doc, latest)
    audit(s, actor.id, "revision.create", "problem_revision", rev.id, base_revision=latest.id)
    return rev


# ─────────────────────────── DB → doc ───────────────────────────
def revision_to_doc(s: Session, rev: ProblemRevision) -> dict:
    problem = s.get(Problem, rev.problem_id)
    md = dict(rev.content_metadata or {})
    refs = md.pop("_source_record_refs", [])
    rights_ref = md.pop("_rights_policy_ref", None)
    assets = md.pop("_assets", [])
    lineage = md.pop("_lineage", [])
    parts = []
    for p in rev.parts:
        spec = p.answer_specs[-1]
        pd = {
            "id": p.id, "logical_part_id": p.logical_part_id, "part_key": p.part_key,
            "display_order": p.display_order, "response_type": p.response_type,
            "max_score": str(Decimal(p.max_score).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))), "prompt": p.prompt,
            "answer_spec": {"spec_version": spec.spec_version, "grading_mode": spec.grading_mode,
                            "checker_type": spec.checker_type, **spec.spec},
            "solutions": [{"type": so.solution_type, "review_state": so.validation_state, **so.content} for so in p.solutions],
        }
        if p.options:
            pd["options"] = p.options
        if p.knowledge_codes:
            pd["knowledge_codes"] = p.knowledge_codes
        if spec.rubric:
            pd["rubric"] = spec.rubric
        steps = s.scalars(select(ReasoningStep).where(ReasoningStep.revision_part_id == p.id)
                          .order_by(ReasoningStep.step_order)).all()
        if steps:
            pd["reasoning_steps"] = [
                {"semantic_key": st.semantic_key, "order": st.step_order, "recall_cue": st.recall_cue,
                 "reference_latex": st.reference_latex, "explanation": st.explanation,
                 "max_points": str(Decimal(st.max_points).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))),
                 "criticality": st.criticality, "knowledge_codes": st.knowledge_codes} for st in steps]
        parts.append(pd)
    doc = {
        "schema_version": "1.0.0",
        "problem": {"id": problem.id, "display_id": problem.display_id, "slug": problem.slug,
                    "grade_band": problem.grade_band, "subject": problem.subject, "visibility": problem.visibility},
        "revision": {"id": rev.id, "revision_no": rev.revision_no, "status": rev.status, "locale": rev.locale,
                     "title": rev.title, "shared_statement": rev.shared_statement, "content_metadata": md,
                     "revision_kind": rev.revision_kind, "parts": parts},
        "source_record_refs": refs,
        "rights_policy_ref": rights_ref or "",
        "assets": assets,
        "lineage": lineage,
    }
    if rev.change_note:
        doc["revision"]["change_note"] = rev.change_note
    return doc


# ─────────────────────────── preflight with DB context ───────────────────────────
def full_preflight(s: Session, rev: ProblemRevision) -> list[dict]:
    doc = revision_to_doc(s, rev)
    issues = preflight(doc)
    grant = s.get(RightsGrant, rev.rights_grant_id) if rev.rights_grant_id else None
    if grant is None:
        issues.append({"code": "RIGHTS_MISSING", "severity": "blocking", "path": "/rights_policy_ref",
                       "message": "no rights grant registered for this revision"})
    elif grant.status == "revoked":
        issues.append({"code": "RIGHTS_REVOKED", "severity": "blocking", "path": "/rights_policy_ref",
                       "message": "rights grant revoked"})
    for m in doc["revision"]["content_metadata"].get("curriculum_mappings", []):
        if _knowledge_node(s, m["curriculum_code"], m["release_code"], m["knowledge_code"]) is None:
            issues.append({"code": "KNOWLEDGE_UNKNOWN", "severity": "warning", "path": "/revision/content_metadata",
                           "message": f"unknown knowledge node {m['knowledge_code']}"})
    for ref in doc["source_record_refs"]:
        src = s.scalar(select(Source).where(Source.code == ref["source_code"]))
        if src is None:
            issues.append({"code": "SOURCE_UNKNOWN", "severity": "blocking", "path": "/source_record_refs",
                           "message": f"source {ref['source_code']} not registered"})
        elif src.status != "active":
            issues.append({"code": "SOURCE_DISABLED", "severity": "blocking", "path": "/source_record_refs",
                           "message": f"source {ref['source_code']} disabled"})
    return issues


def _blocking(issues: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    return [i for i in issues if i["severity"] == "blocking"]


# ─────────────────────────── workflow transitions ───────────────────────────
def submit_review(s: Session, rev: ProblemRevision, actor: User, note: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    require_roles(actor, "editor", "source_manager")
    if rev.status != "draft":
        raise ApiError("INVALID_STATE", f"cannot submit from {rev.status}")
    issues = full_preflight(s, rev)
    if _blocking(issues):
        audit(s, actor.id, "revision.preflight_failed", "problem_revision", rev.id, issues=len(issues))
        raise ApiError("PREFLIGHT_FAILED", "blocking issues must be fixed before review", {"issues": issues})
    warnings = [i for i in issues if i["severity"] == "warning"]
    _record_workflow(s, rev, "in_math_review", actor, note or (f"{len(warnings)} warning(s)" if warnings else None))
    return issues


def approve_math(s: Session, rev: ProblemRevision, actor: User, note: str | None = None) -> None:
    require_roles(actor, "reviewer")
    if rev.status != "in_math_review":
        raise ApiError("INVALID_STATE", f"not in math review (status={rev.status})")
    if actor.id == rev.created_by:
        raise ApiError("SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN", "reviewers cannot approve their own content")
    rev.math_reviewer_id = actor.id
    rev.review_note = note
    _record_workflow(s, rev, "in_rights_review", actor, note)


def approve_rights(s: Session, rev: ProblemRevision, actor: User, note: str | None = None) -> None:
    require_roles(actor, "rights_reviewer")
    if rev.status != "in_rights_review":
        raise ApiError("INVALID_STATE", f"not in rights review (status={rev.status})")
    if actor.id == rev.created_by:
        raise ApiError("SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN", "reviewers cannot approve their own content")
    if settings.require_distinct_reviewers and actor.id == rev.math_reviewer_id:
        raise ApiError("SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN", "math and rights gates need two different reviewers")
    grant = s.get(RightsGrant, rev.rights_grant_id) if rev.rights_grant_id else None
    ok, why = grant_allows(grant, "display")
    if not ok:
        raise ApiError("RIGHTS_HOLD", f"rights gate failed: {why}")
    rev.rights_reviewer_id = actor.id
    _record_workflow(s, rev, "approved", actor, note)


def reject(s: Session, rev: ProblemRevision, actor: User, reason: str) -> None:
    require_roles(actor, "reviewer", "rights_reviewer")
    if rev.status not in ("in_math_review", "in_rights_review", "approved"):
        raise ApiError("INVALID_STATE", f"cannot reject from {rev.status}")
    if not reason or not reason.strip():
        raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "a rejection reason is required")
    rev.math_reviewer_id = None
    rev.rights_reviewer_id = None
    rev.review_note = reason
    _record_workflow(s, rev, "draft", actor, f"changes requested: {reason}")


def publish(s: Session, rev: ProblemRevision, actor: User) -> ProblemRevision:
    require_roles(actor, "reviewer")
    if rev.status != "approved":
        raise ApiError("INVALID_STATE", f"only approved revisions can be published (status={rev.status})")
    if not (rev.math_reviewer_id and rev.rights_reviewer_id):
        raise ApiError("INVALID_STATE", "both math and rights gates must be passed")
    issues = _blocking(full_preflight(s, rev))
    if issues:
        raise ApiError("PREFLIGHT_FAILED", "blocking issues", {"issues": issues})
    grant = s.get(RightsGrant, rev.rights_grant_id)
    ok, why = grant_allows(grant, "display")
    if not ok:
        raise ApiError("RIGHTS_HOLD", f"rights gate failed: {why}")
    problem = s.get(Problem, rev.problem_id)
    previous = s.get(ProblemRevision, problem.current_public_revision_id) if problem.current_public_revision_id else None
    rev.content_hash = content_hash(revision_to_doc(s, rev))
    rev.published_at = utcnow()
    _record_workflow(s, rev, "published", actor)
    if previous is not None and previous.id != rev.id and previous.status == "published":
        _record_workflow(s, previous, "archived", actor, f"superseded by revision {rev.revision_no}")
    problem.current_public_revision_id = rev.id
    s.flush()
    rebuild_search_document(s, problem)
    outbox(s, "problem.published", problem_id=problem.id, revision_id=rev.id)
    return rev


def retract(s: Session, rev: ProblemRevision, actor: User, reason: str) -> None:
    require_roles(actor, "reviewer", "rights_reviewer")
    if rev.status != "published":
        raise ApiError("INVALID_STATE", f"only published revisions can be retracted (status={rev.status})")
    if not reason:
        raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "a retraction reason is required")
    problem = s.get(Problem, rev.problem_id)
    rev.retracted_at = utcnow()
    _record_workflow(s, rev, "retracted", actor, reason)
    if problem.current_public_revision_id == rev.id:
        problem.current_public_revision_id = None
    s.flush()
    rebuild_search_document(s, problem)
    outbox(s, "problem.retracted", problem_id=problem.id, revision_id=rev.id)


def set_takedown_hold(s: Session, problem: Problem, actor: User, hold: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    require_roles(actor, "rights_reviewer")
    problem.takedown_hold = hold
    problem.takedown_reason = reason if hold else None
    audit(s, actor.id, "problem.rights_hold" if hold else "problem.rights_release", "problem", problem.id, reason=reason)
    s.flush()
    rebuild_search_document(s, problem)


def set_grading_suspended(s: Session, part: RevisionPart, actor: User, suspended: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    require_roles(actor, "reviewer")
    part.grading_suspended = suspended
    audit(s, actor.id, "part.grading_suspended" if suspended else "part.grading_resumed", "revision_part", part.id, reason=reason)


# ─────────────────────────── public visibility ───────────────────────────
def public_revision(s: Session, problem: Problem | None) -> ProblemRevision | None:
    """The single gate every public read goes through (AC-005)."""
    if problem is None or problem.deleted_at or problem.visibility != "public" or problem.takedown_hold:
        return None
    if not problem.current_public_revision_id:
        return None
    rev = s.get(ProblemRevision, problem.current_public_revision_id)
    if rev is None or rev.status != "published":
        return None
    grant = s.get(RightsGrant, rev.rights_grant_id) if rev.rights_grant_id else None
    ok, _ = grant_allows(grant, "display")
    return rev if ok else None


def find_problem_by_slug(s: Session, slug: str) -> Problem | None:
    p = s.scalar(select(Problem).where(Problem.slug == slug))
    if p is None:
        alias = s.get(SlugAlias, slug)
        p = s.get(Problem, alias.problem_id) if alias else None
    if p is None:
        p = s.scalar(select(Problem).where(Problem.display_id == slug.upper()))
    return p


def rename_slug(s: Session, problem: Problem, new_slug: str, actor: User) -> None:
    require_roles(actor, "editor")
    if not re.match(r"^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$", new_slug):
        raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "invalid slug")
    if _slug_taken(s, new_slug, problem.id):
        raise ApiError("CONFLICT", "slug already used (slugs are never re-used)")
    if s.get(SlugAlias, problem.slug) is None:
        s.add(SlugAlias(slug=problem.slug, problem_id=problem.id))
    problem.slug = new_slug
    audit(s, actor.id, "problem.rename_slug", "problem", problem.id, slug=new_slug)
    s.flush()
    rebuild_search_document(s, problem)


# ─────────────────────────── search read-model ───────────────────────────
def rebuild_search_document(s: Session, problem: Problem) -> None:
    existing = s.get(SearchDocument, problem.id)
    rev = s.get(ProblemRevision, problem.current_public_revision_id) if problem.current_public_revision_id else None
    if rev is None or rev.status != "published" or problem.takedown_hold or problem.visibility != "public":
        if existing:
            s.delete(existing)
        return
    nodes = s.execute(
        select(KnowledgeNode.id, KnowledgeNode.title, KnowledgeNode.external_code)
        .join(RevisionKnowledge, RevisionKnowledge.knowledge_node_id == KnowledgeNode.id)
        .where(RevisionKnowledge.revision_id == rev.id)
    ).all()
    # Include ancestors so filtering by a chapter node finds problems tagged with its children.
    ids = set()
    for nid, _t, _c in nodes:
        cur = s.get(KnowledgeNode, nid)
        while cur is not None:
            ids.add(cur.id)
            cur = s.get(KnowledgeNode, cur.parent_id) if cur.parent_id else None
    body = [to_plain_text(rev.shared_statement)] + [to_plain_text(p.prompt) for p in rev.parts]
    md = rev.content_metadata or {}
    src_kind = "internal"
    sr = s.scalar(select(SourceRecord).where(SourceRecord.canonical_problem_id == problem.id).limit(1))
    if sr:
        src = s.get(Source, sr.source_id)
        src_kind = src.kind if src else src_kind
    doc = existing or SearchDocument(problem_id=problem.id)
    doc.revision_id = rev.id
    doc.display_id = problem.display_id
    doc.slug = problem.slug
    doc.title = rev.title
    doc.body_text = " ".join(body)
    doc.knowledge_text = " ".join(f"{t} {c}" for _i, t, c in nodes)
    doc.knowledge_ids = "," + ",".join(sorted(ids)) + ","
    doc.grade_band = problem.grade_band
    doc.region_hints = "," + ",".join(md.get("region_hints", [])) + ","
    doc.response_types = "," + ",".join(sorted({p.response_type for p in rev.parts})) + ","
    doc.difficulty = rev.platform_difficulty or 0
    doc.part_count = len(rev.parts)
    doc.has_solution = all(p.solutions for p in rev.parts)
    doc.source_kind = src_kind
    doc.rights_grant_id = rev.rights_grant_id
    doc.updated_at = rev.published_at or utcnow()
    if existing is None:
        s.add(doc)


def problem_count(s: Session) -> int:
    return s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(Problem)) or 0


def now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)

"""Public catalog search over the read model (docs/09 §1–2, docs/07 §2).

* Only public + published + current + rights-valid (checked at query time, so expiry is immediate).
* Keyset (cursor) pagination with a stable tie-breaker → no duplicates / gaps across pages.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy import and_, case, func, literal, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ..models import Attempt, Problem, ProblemRevision, RightsGrant, SearchDocument
from .errors import ApiError
from .rights import valid_grant_clause

SORTS = {"relevance", "display_id", "updated_desc", "difficulty_asc", "difficulty_desc"}


def _enc(values: list) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(values, default=str).encode()).decode().rstrip("=")


def _dec(cursor: str) -> list:
    try:
        pad = "=" * (-len(cursor) % 4)
        return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(cursor + pad))
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "invalid cursor") from e


def _escape_like(q: str) -> str:
    return q.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")


def search(
    s: Session,
    *,
    query: str | None = None,
    grade_band: str | None = None,
    region: str | None = None,
    knowledge_id: str | None = None,
    difficulty_min: int | None = None,
    difficulty_max: int | None = None,
    response_type: str | None = None,
    source_kind: str | None = None,
    has_solution: bool | None = None,
    attempted: bool | None = None,
    user_id: str | None = None,
    sort: str | None = None,
    limit: int = 20,
    cursor: str | None = None,
) -> dict:
    if not 1 <= limit <= 100:
        raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "limit must be 1..100")
    q = (query or "").strip()
    sort = sort or ("relevance" if q else "display_id")
    if sort not in SORTS:
        raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", f"sort must be one of {sorted(SORTS)}")
    if sort == "relevance" and not q:
        sort = "display_id"
    D = SearchDocument
    stmt = (
        select(D)
        .join(Problem, Problem.id == D.problem_id)
        .join(ProblemRevision, ProblemRevision.id == D.revision_id)
        .join(RightsGrant, RightsGrant.id == D.rights_grant_id)
        .where(
            Problem.takedown_hold.is_(False),
            Problem.visibility == "public",
            Problem.deleted_at.is_(None),
            Problem.current_public_revision_id == D.revision_id,
            ProblemRevision.status == "published",
            valid_grant_clause(),
            RightsGrant.allows_display.is_(True),
        )
    )
    rank = literal(0)
    if q:
        terms = [t for t in q.split() if t][:8]
        for t in terms:
            pat = f"%{_escape_like(t)}%"
            stmt = stmt.where(or_(
                func.upper(D.display_id) == t.upper(),
                D.title.like(pat, escape="\\"), D.knowledge_text.like(pat, escape="\\"),
                D.body_text.like(pat, escape="\\"),
            ))
        full = f"%{_escape_like(q)}%"
        rank = case(
            (func.upper(D.display_id) == q.upper(), 0),
            (D.title.like(full, escape="\\"), 1),
            (D.knowledge_text.like(full, escape="\\"), 2),
            else_=3,
        )
    if grade_band:
        stmt = stmt.where(D.grade_band == grade_band)
    if region:
        stmt = stmt.where(D.region_hints.like(f"%,{_escape_like(region)},%", escape="\\"))
    if knowledge_id:
        stmt = stmt.where(D.knowledge_ids.like(f"%,{_escape_like(knowledge_id)},%", escape="\\"))
    if difficulty_min is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(D.difficulty >= difficulty_min)
    if difficulty_max is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(D.difficulty <= difficulty_max)
    if response_type:
        stmt = stmt.where(D.response_types.like(f"%,{_escape_like(response_type)},%", escape="\\"))
    if source_kind:
        stmt = stmt.where(D.source_kind == source_kind)
    if has_solution is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(D.has_solution.is_(has_solution))
    if attempted is not None and user_id:
        done = select(ProblemRevision.problem_id).join(Attempt, Attempt.problem_revision_id == ProblemRevision.id).where(Attempt.user_id == user_id)
        stmt = stmt.where(D.problem_id.in_(done) if attempted else D.problem_id.not_in(done))

    # (expression, descending?) — always ends with display_id + problem_id as stable tie-breakers.
    keys: list[tuple] = {
        "relevance": [(rank, False)],
        "display_id": [],
        "updated_desc": [(D.updated_at, True)],
        "difficulty_asc": [(D.difficulty, False)],
        "difficulty_desc": [(D.difficulty, True)],
    }[sort] + [(D.display_id, False), (D.problem_id, False)]

    if cursor:
        vals = _dec(cursor)
        if len(vals) != len(keys):
            raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "cursor does not match sort")
        vals = [datetime.fromisoformat(v) if isinstance(v, str) and expr is D.updated_at else v
                for (expr, _), v in zip(keys, vals)]
        ors = []
        for i, (expr, desc) in enumerate(keys):
            eqs = [keys[j][0] == vals[j] for j in range(i)]
            ors.append(and_(*eqs, expr < vals[i] if desc else expr > vals[i]))
        stmt = stmt.where(or_(*ors))
    stmt = stmt.add_columns(*[k[0].label(f"k{i}") for i, k in enumerate(keys)])
    stmt = stmt.order_by(*[k[0].desc() if k[1] else k[0].asc() for k in keys]).limit(limit + 1)
    rows = s.execute(stmt).all()
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]
    items = [r[0] for r in rows]
    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        last = rows[-1]
        next_cursor = _enc([last[i + 1] for i in range(len(keys))])
    return {"items": items, "next_cursor": next_cursor, "has_more": has_more, "sort": sort}

"""Attempts, submissions, evaluations, bookmarks, mistakes, progress, reports (docs/06, docs/09)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import time
from collections import defaultdict, deque
from decimal import Decimal

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ..config import settings
from ..content.contract import canonical_json, sha256_text
from ..grading.engine import grade
from ..models import (
    AnswerSpec,
    Attempt,
    Bookmark,
    ContentReport,
    Evaluation,
    KnowledgeNode,
    MistakeMark,
    Problem,
    ProblemRevision,
    RevisionKnowledge,
    RevisionPart,
    Submission,
    User,
    utcnow,
)
from .audit import audit
from .catalog import public_revision, require_roles
from .errors import ApiError

MATH_VERDICTS = {"accepted", "rejected", "partial"}

# ─────────────────────────── rate limiting (per user, in-process) ───────────────────────────
_buckets: dict[str, deque] = defaultdict(deque)


def rate_limit(key: str, per_minute: int | None = None) -> None:
    per_minute = per_minute or settings.rate_limit_per_minute
    now = time.monotonic()
    q = _buckets[key]
    while q and now - q[0] > 60:
        q.popleft()
    if len(q) >= per_minute:
        raise ApiError("RATE_LIMITED", "too many requests, slow down", {"retry_after_s": int(60 - (now - q[0])) + 1})
    q.append(now)


# ─────────────────────────── attempts & submissions ───────────────────────────
def _assert_revision_playable(s: Session, rev: ProblemRevision) -> None:
    problem = s.get(Problem, rev.problem_id)
    if rev.status == "retracted":
        raise ApiError("CONTENT_RETRACTED", "this problem has been retracted")
    current = public_revision(s, problem)
    if current is None:
        if rev.status in ("published", "archived") and (problem.takedown_hold or problem.current_public_revision_id == rev.id):
            raise ApiError("RIGHTS_HOLD", "this problem is temporarily unavailable")
        if rev.status == "archived":
            raise ApiError("REVISION_SUPERSEDED", "a newer revision exists", {"current_revision_id": problem.current_public_revision_id})
        raise ApiError("NOT_FOUND", "problem not found")
    if current.id != rev.id:
        raise ApiError("REVISION_SUPERSEDED", "a newer revision exists", {"current_revision_id": current.id})


def create_attempt(s: Session, user: User, problem_revision_id: str, mode: str = "practice") -> Attempt:
    rev = s.get(ProblemRevision, problem_revision_id)
    if rev is None:
        raise ApiError("NOT_FOUND", "revision not found")
    _assert_revision_playable(s, rev)
    att = Attempt(user_id=user.id, problem_revision_id=rev.id, mode=mode)
    s.add(att)
    s.flush()
    return att


def _latest_eval(s: Session, submission_id: str) -> Evaluation | None:
    return s.scalar(select(Evaluation).where(Evaluation.submission_id == submission_id)
                    .order_by(Evaluation.created_at.desc(), Evaluation.id.desc()).limit(1))


def submit(s: Session, user: User, attempt_id: str, revision_part_id: str, response: dict, idem_key: str) -> tuple[Submission, Evaluation, bool]:
    """Returns (submission, evaluation, replayed)."""
    if not idem_key or not (8 <= len(idem_key) <= 128):
        raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "Idempotency-Key header (8..128 chars) is required")
    att = s.get(Attempt, attempt_id)
    if att is None or att.user_id != user.id:  # never reveal other users' attempts
        raise ApiError("NOT_FOUND", "attempt not found")
    req_hash = sha256_text(canonical_json({"part": revision_part_id, "response": response}))
    existing = s.scalar(select(Submission).where(Submission.attempt_id == att.id, Submission.idempotency_key == idem_key))
    if existing is not None:
        if sha256_text(canonical_json({"part": existing.revision_part_id, "response": existing.response})) != req_hash:
            raise ApiError("IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT", "Idempotency-Key reused with a different request body")
        return existing, _latest_eval(s, existing.id), True
    part = s.get(RevisionPart, revision_part_id)
    if part is None or part.problem_revision_id != att.problem_revision_id:
        raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "revision_part_id does not belong to this attempt's revision")
    if not isinstance(response, dict) or not isinstance(response.get("input"), str):
        raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "response.input must be a string")
    rev = s.get(ProblemRevision, att.problem_revision_id)
    _assert_revision_playable(s, rev)
    rate_limit(f"submit:{user.id}")
    spec: AnswerSpec = part.answer_specs[-1]
    sub = Submission(attempt_id=att.id, user_id=user.id, revision_part_id=part.id, answer_spec_id=spec.id,
                     response={"type": response.get("type", part.response_type), "input": response["input"][:2000]},
                     idempotency_key=idem_key)
    s.add(sub)
    s.flush()
    if part.grading_suspended:
        from ..grading.checkers import pending

        result = pending(Decimal(part.max_score), "GRADING_SUSPENDED", "该小问自动判题已暂停，提交将人工复核")
    else:
        option_ids = {o["id"] for o in (part.options or [])}
        result = grade(part.response_type, spec.grading_mode, spec.checker_type, spec.spec, response["input"],
                       Decimal(part.max_score), option_ids)
    ev = Evaluation(
        submission_id=sub.id, grader_name=result.grader_name, grader_version=result.grader_version,
        state=result.status, result_code=result.result_code,
        score=Decimal(result.score) if result.score is not None else None, max_score=Decimal(result.max_score),
        feedback={"message": result.message, **_public_details(result.details)},
    )
    s.add(ev)
    s.flush()
    _update_mistake(s, user.id, part.id, sub.id, ev.state)
    return sub, ev, False


def _public_details(details: dict) -> dict:
    # Never leak the hidden expected answer or internal sample points.
    return {k: v for k, v in details.items() if k in ("assumptions", "hybrid", "missing", "extra", "tolerance")}


def _update_mistake(s: Session, user_id: str, part_id: str, sub_id: str, state: str) -> None:
    """Only completed math verdicts rejected/partial create a mistake mark (docs/09 §6)."""
    mark = s.get(MistakeMark, (user_id, part_id))
    if state in ("rejected", "partial") and mark is None:
        s.add(MistakeMark(user_id=user_id, revision_part_id=part_id, origin_submission_id=sub_id))


def append_evaluation(s: Session, actor: User, submission: Submission, state: str, score: Decimal | None,
                      reason: str, matched: list[str] | None = None, regrade: bool = False) -> Evaluation:
    """Manual grading / regrade. Appends; never edits a previous evaluation (docs/06 §6)."""
    require_roles(actor, "reviewer")
    if state not in MATH_VERDICTS | {"pending_review"}:
        raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "invalid evaluation state")
    part = s.get(RevisionPart, submission.revision_part_id)
    max_score = Decimal(part.max_score)
    if state in MATH_VERDICTS:
        if score is None or not (Decimal(0) <= score <= max_score):
            raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", f"score must be within 0..{max_score}")
        if state == "accepted" and score != max_score:
            raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "accepted requires full score; use partial")
    if not reason:
        raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "reason required")
    prev = _latest_eval(s, submission.id)
    ev = Evaluation(submission_id=submission.id, grader_name="human" if not regrade else "regrade",
                    grader_version="manual-1", state=state, result_code="MANUAL_REGRADE" if regrade else "MANUAL",
                    score=score, max_score=max_score,
                    feedback={"message": "评分已修订" if regrade else "教师已批改", "matched_criteria": matched or []},
                    evaluator_id=actor.id, previous_evaluation_id=prev.id if prev else None, reason=reason)
    s.add(ev)
    s.flush()
    audit(s, actor.id, "evaluation.append", "submission", submission.id, previous=prev.id if prev else None, state=state)
    _update_mistake(s, submission.user_id, part.id, submission.id, state)
    return ev


def regrade_submission(s: Session, actor: User, submission: Submission, reason: str) -> Evaluation:
    """Re-run the deterministic grader with the *original* answer spec; append the new result."""
    require_roles(actor, "reviewer")
    part = s.get(RevisionPart, submission.revision_part_id)
    spec = s.get(AnswerSpec, submission.answer_spec_id)
    r = grade(part.response_type, spec.grading_mode, spec.checker_type, spec.spec, submission.response["input"],
              Decimal(part.max_score), {o["id"] for o in part.options or []})
    prev = _latest_eval(s, submission.id)
    ev = Evaluation(submission_id=submission.id, grader_name=r.grader_name, grader_version=r.grader_version,
                    state=r.status, result_code=r.result_code,
                    score=Decimal(r.score) if r.score is not None else None, max_score=Decimal(r.max_score),
                    feedback={"message": "评分已修订：" + r.message}, evaluator_id=actor.id,
                    previous_evaluation_id=prev.id if prev else None, reason=reason)
    s.add(ev)
    s.flush()
    audit(s, actor.id, "evaluation.regrade", "submission", submission.id, previous=prev.id if prev else None)
    return ev


def manual_queue(s: Session, limit: int = 50) -> list[tuple[Submission, Evaluation]]:
    subs = s.scalars(select(Submission).order_by(Submission.created_at.asc())).all()
    out = []
    for sub in subs:
        ev = _latest_eval(s, sub.id)
        if ev and ev.state == "pending_review":
            out.append((sub, ev))
        if len(out) >= limit:
            break
    return out


# ─────────────────────────── personal learning ───────────────────────────
def toggle_bookmark(s: Session, user: User, problem_id: str, on: bool) -> None:
    problem = s.get(Problem, problem_id)
    if on:
        if public_revision(s, problem) is None:
            raise ApiError("NOT_FOUND", "problem not found")
        if s.get(Bookmark, (user.id, problem_id)) is None:
            s.add(Bookmark(user_id=user.id, problem_id=problem_id))
    else:
        b = s.get(Bookmark, (user.id, problem_id))
        if b:
            s.delete(b)


def part_progress(s: Session, user_id: str) -> dict[str, dict]:
    """Per revision_part: attempts, accepted count, latest effective state."""
    out: dict[str, dict] = {}
    subs = s.scalars(select(Submission).where(Submission.user_id == user_id).order_by(Submission.created_at)).all()
    for sub in subs:
        ev = _latest_eval(s, sub.id)
        st = out.setdefault(sub.revision_part_id, {"attempt_count": 0, "accepted_count": 0, "latest_state": None,
                                                   "last_attempt_at": None, "best_score": None})
        st["attempt_count"] += 1
        if ev and ev.state == "accepted":
            st["accepted_count"] += 1
        st["latest_state"] = ev.state if ev else None
        st["last_attempt_at"] = sub.created_at.isoformat()
        if ev and ev.score is not None:
            st["best_score"] = str(max(Decimal(st["best_score"] or 0), Decimal(ev.score)))
    return out


def knowledge_progress(s: Session, user_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    """P0: attempts/correct ratio per *tested* knowledge node, with explicit sample size (docs/09 §5)."""
    pp = part_progress(s, user_id)
    agg: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for part_id, st in pp.items():
        part = s.get(RevisionPart, part_id)
        nodes = s.scalars(select(KnowledgeNode).join(RevisionKnowledge, RevisionKnowledge.knowledge_node_id == KnowledgeNode.id)
                          .where(RevisionKnowledge.revision_id == part.problem_revision_id,
                                 RevisionKnowledge.relation_type == "tested")).all()
        codes = set(part.knowledge_codes or [])
        for n in nodes:
            if codes and n.external_code not in codes:
                continue
            a = agg.setdefault(n.id, {"knowledge_id": n.id, "code": n.external_code, "title": n.title,
                                      "parts_attempted": 0, "parts_accepted": 0, "submissions": 0})
            a["parts_attempted"] += 1
            a["submissions"] += st["attempt_count"]
            a["parts_accepted"] += 1 if st["accepted_count"] else 0
    for a in agg.values():
        a["accuracy"] = round(a["parts_accepted"] / a["parts_attempted"], 3) if a["parts_attempted"] else None
        a["low_sample"] = a["parts_attempted"] < 5
    return sorted(agg.values(), key=lambda x: x["code"])


def problem_progress(s: Session, user_id: str, rev: ProblemRevision) -> dict:
    """Group-level: a problem is 'completed' only if *every* part is accepted (no 1-of-3 = solved)."""
    pp = part_progress(s, user_id)
    parts = {p.id: pp.get(p.id) for p in rev.parts}
    accepted = sum(1 for v in parts.values() if v and v["accepted_count"])
    return {"parts": parts, "parts_accepted": accepted, "part_count": len(parts),
            "completed": accepted == len(parts) and len(parts) > 0}


def create_report(s: Session, user: User, problem_revision_id: str, kind: str, description: str,
                  revision_part_id: str | None = None, evaluation_id: str | None = None) -> ContentReport:
    rev = s.get(ProblemRevision, problem_revision_id)
    if rev is None or rev.status not in ("published", "archived", "retracted"):
        raise ApiError("NOT_FOUND", "revision not found")
    kinds = {"wrong_answer", "ambiguous", "missing_image", "misjudged", "rights", "typo", "other"}
    if kind not in kinds:
        raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", f"kind must be one of {sorted(kinds)}")
    if revision_part_id:
        part = s.get(RevisionPart, revision_part_id)
        if part is None or part.problem_revision_id != rev.id:
            raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "part does not belong to revision")
    if evaluation_id:
        ev = s.get(Evaluation, evaluation_id)
        sub = s.get(Submission, ev.submission_id) if ev else None
        if sub is None or sub.user_id != user.id:
            raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "evaluation not found")
    severity = "P0" if kind in ("wrong_answer", "rights", "misjudged") else "P1" if kind == "ambiguous" else "P2"
    r = ContentReport(reporter_id=user.id, problem_revision_id=rev.id, revision_part_id=revision_part_id,
                      evaluation_id=evaluation_id, kind=kind, description=description[:4000], severity=severity)
    s.add(r)
    s.flush()
    audit(s, user.id, "report.create", "content_report", r.id, severity=severity)
    return r


def resolve_report(s: Session, actor: User, report: ContentReport, state: str, resolution: str,
                   public_note: str | None, internal_note: str | None) -> None:
    require_roles(actor, "reviewer", "rights_reviewer")
    if state not in ("triaged", "resolved", "rejected"):
        raise ApiError("VALIDATION_FAILED", "invalid state")
    report.state = state
    report.resolution = resolution
    report.public_note = public_note
    report.internal_note = internal_note
    report.reviewer_id = actor.id
    report.updated_at = utcnow()
    audit(s, actor.id, f"report.{state}", "content_report", report.id, resolution=resolution)

"""Content-addressed object store (local FS for dev; S3-compatible in production)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

from ..config import settings


def put_bytes(data: bytes, prefix: str = "raw") -> tuple[str, str]:
    sha = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    key = f"{prefix}/{sha[:2]}/{sha}"
    path = Path(settings.storage_dir) / key
    if not path.exists():
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(data)
    return key, sha


def get_bytes(key: str) -> bytes:
    if ".." in key:
        raise ValueError("bad key")
    return (Path(settings.storage_dir) / key).read_bytes()
